description: Inheriting the prototype's architecture by inertia
mitigation: ADR-001 must compare alternatives explicitly (A21).

description: Global preference side effects corrupting a user's later analyses once the work moves to a persistent Fiji session
mitigation: CR in A11/A19 to snapshot and restore prefs, or to pass every option explicitly.

description: Scope creep towards full Fiji parity before the hackathon
mitigation: the tiered scope in A31.

description: NL/voice features dominate the demo and the UI drifts back to a prompt box
mitigation: D11/D12 make the viewer and menus primary, with NL/voice as auxiliary panels

description: The personas do not match the actual user mix of the target deployment
mitigation: a short structured interview with 3–5 users per persona before D-stage UI commitments; check against image.sc question categories.

description: Modernisation alienates PER-4 (power users), who are disproportionately the people writing forum answers and training material
mitigation: CR-A02-01/02/05; ship a "classic" layout; keep the macro tooling unchanged.

description: Survey-derived needs reflect respondents recruited through open-source channels, not wet-lab users who never post
mitigation: treat the PER-1 needs as hypotheses and test them with usability sessions (D-stage).

description: The inventory may not reflect real usage frequency. No usage telemetry exists, and the selection follows tutorials
mitigation: validate against image.sc tag frequencies, or a short user survey (A02).

description: Documentation-derived steps may differ from pinned behaviour, as the Coloc 2 path already does
mitigation: a runtime Recorder walk-through of W01–W13 on the pinned Fiji, stored as probes.

description: Plugin GUIs (TrackMate, TWS) may not embed in a new shell without modification
mitigation: A15-type analysis of GUI dependence before design commits.

description: A redesigned dialog emits option strings that differ from the legacy `GenericDialog`, which silently breaks recorded macros
mitigation: Generate forms from the legacy dialog fields; add a golden-string parity test per command (A30)

description: Single-key shortcuts conflict with modern text inputs, the command palette or voice push-to-talk keys
mitigation: Scope single-key bindings to viewport focus; make the push-to-talk key configurable; publish a conflict table

description: Hosting legacy AWT windows inside a modern shell is infeasible, so plugin windows float outside the workspace
mitigation: Accept floating legacy windows as a fallback; assess in A15

description: A "current image" ambiguity between the modern viewer and `WindowManager` causes commands to run on the wrong image
mitigation: Single source of truth: the modern UI sets `WindowManager.setCurrentWindow`/`setTempCurrentImage` before every command; add a test

description: Recorder gaps (P50) propagate into the NL/voice history, giving non-replayable scripts
mitigation: Build history from the command + option strings actually executed, not from the Recorder text; verify by replay

description: Users rely on undocumented legacy behaviour (window-enlarging zoom, `Undo.reset` on switch); changing it causes confusion or different results
mitigation: Document deliberate deviations; keep pixel operations identical; usability-test with expert users

description: GUI-based tests and screenshots cannot run while the user's desktop is locked or the screen saver is active
mitigation: Use the in-process (`printAll`) and `PrintWindow` methods (P50/P51); schedule interactive captures

description: A GUI run writes SciJava preferences to the registry immediately (P52), so state leaks between test runs
mitigation: Isolate preferences (separate Windows user or a `java.util.prefs` override) in automated GUI tests; UNKNOWN whether an override property exists, to be checked in scijava-common `PrefService`

description: Exposing global options per command may overwhelm beginners
mitigation: show only the options that differ from the defaults, or that are relevant to the command (D-stage).

description: A history-based undo that goes beyond ImageJ's single buffer requires snapshots, with memory cost for large stacks
mitigation: replay-from-source or disk snapshots; feasibility in A-stage feasibility documents.

description: Source-derived recorder findings (UP-04, UP-10) may be incomplete because other recording paths exist
mitigation: runtime Recorder probes for W01, W02 and W05.

description: Binding ROIs and results per image may diverge from IJ1 macro expectations of global state
mitigation: keep the global IJ1 objects authoritative for macros and treat the bindings as a view (CR-A05-05).

description: The official fiji-llm project makes this project's natural-language layer redundant, or the two become incompatible
mitigation: decide on Option A/B/C early; contact the fiji-llm maintainers through image.sc or GitHub before the D-stage.

description: Reviewers or users perceive the product as an "AI wrapper" without a differentiator
mitigation: lead with fidelity (unchanged semantics, replayable `run()` history) and the workstation UX, not with AI.

description: Third-party tool facts change quickly; fiji-llm and napari are both under active development
mitigation: re-check F3 and F7 at each stage gate and record revisions in the upstream manifest.

description: LLM-generated macros may be wrong in ways that are hard to see. The benchmark (Haase et al. 2024) and bia-bob's own disclaimer both call for verification
mitigation: restrict execution to catalogued commands with validated parameters (CR-A06-02); numerical parity tests (A30/D18).

description: Upstream changes to ij1-patcher/imagej-legacy hooks (for example, the 3.0.0 major version) break a JVM-resident adapter
mitigation: Pin versions; contract tests on hook behaviour (P41/P42 re-run per Fiji update)

description: A hidden `ij.ImageJ` frame means IJ1 windows still pop up under a new UI
mitigation: Window policy in [A15](A15-gui-dependence-reuse-boundaries.md) §7 and CR-A15-03; batch mode or explicit window management

description: The JVM fails to exit, leaving orphan processes
mitigation: Watchdog plus `Runtime.halt` after a context-dispose timeout

description: Only one IJ1 per JVM, so no isolation between workflows
mitigation: One JVM per user session; per-thread state discipline ([A15](A15-gui-dependence-reuse-boundaries.md) §6)

description: Label drift across versions
mitigation: pin the version; regenerate `commands.csv` with P10–P12 on every runtime change; diff the labels.

description: Silent failure in headless execution
impact: high (wrong or no scientific output reported as success)
mitigation: CR-A08-03 postcondition checks; install a log/error hook; never treat a return from `IJ.run` as success.

description: State-dependent defaults
mitigation: CR-A08-04/05; snapshot relevant Prefs before each run and record them with provenance.

description: Third-party plugin behaviour not audited
mitigation: treat non-core rows as `untested`; probe on demand before exposing them to NL.

description: Exit hangs in headless runs
mitigation: CR-A08-08. The root cause (a lingering non-daemon thread after `ExtendedPlugInFilter` runs) is UNKNOWN; verify with a thread dump (`jcmd <pid> Thread.print`) during an exit-hang.

description: The frontend's image list drifts from the backend's (missed events, external macros opening images)
mitigation: Poll or re-query `WindowManager.getIDList()` after each command, and show a visible "re-sync" state.

description: Users unknowingly alter data by converting after contrast adjustment
mitigation: Show a conversion confirmation that displays the mapping, and record provenance (CR-A09-03).

description: Snapshot-based undo exhausts memory on large stacks
mitigation: Set a memory budget, disable undo with a visible notice above a threshold, and use disk-backed snapshots.

description: A concurrent macro and UI action corrupt state through shared statics
mitigation: Use a single worker queue (CR-A09-07) and block the UI while a macro is running.

description: ImageJ2/legacy synchronisation causes a third representation and lag
mitigation: Prefer IJ1 objects as the backend truth, and measure legacy synchronisation in a GUI-mode probe.

description: Frontend geometry and backend masks differ by half a pixel, which silently changes measurements
mitigation: Use the conformance test in CR-A10-03, and render the backend mask outline in the UI.

description: Workflows that rely on `RoiManager` fail headless
mitigation: Decide on a hidden-GUI JVM or a custom ROI store (escalated to A15/A21).

description: Recorded macros lose sub-pixel ROIs, so replay differs from the interactive result
mitigation: Generate ROI-creation code from the frontend model with float `makeSelection` arrays, or serialise ROIs to `.roi` beside the macro (A12).

description: Upstream fixes `containsPoint` or the point-position behaviour, which changes results across versions
mitigation: Pin the IJ1 version and re-run P35 on upgrade.

description: Very large polygons (over 65,535 points) or huge images exceed `.roi` limits
mitigation: Validate before saving and warn the user.

description: A replayed workflow gives different numbers because globals differ between sessions or machines
mitigation: Snapshot and restore globals (CR-A11-03), and add a "settings drift" warning.

description: Headless Measure loses rows, so batch results are incomplete
likelihood: high (already true in the prototype architecture for more than one measure)
mitigation: CR-A11-05, plus a regression test based on P39.

description: Omitted option keys pick up the last GUI values
mitigation: CR-A11-02, with schema validation that rejects incomplete option sets.

description: Preview in the frontend differs from the final result (different code or a decimated copy)
mitigation: Label previews as approximate, or run the exact command on a duplicate.

description: Exported CSVs are rounded, which harms downstream statistics
mitigation: CR-A11-04: export from the backend's raw values.

description: Multithreaded filters are non-deterministic in the last bits
mitigation: Add an A30 tolerance, and optionally pin `Prefs.setThreads(1)` in verification runs.

description: Users expect the Recorder to capture actions done in the new UI, but nothing is recorded headless
mitigation: Provide the project's own history panel with "export as macro" (CR-A12-01), and document that the Recorder is not used.

description: Option-key collisions (`_`/digit prefixes, duplicate first words) cause wrong parameter binding
mitigation: Validate generated option strings against the dialog schema, and add a P34-style unit test per command.

description: A malicious or careless user macro deletes files or runs processes
mitigation: CR-A12-07, separate JVM, working directory sandbox; A25 policy.

description: A `#@` script run through the wrong path fails silently, so the user believes it ran
mitigation: CR-A12-06, and require a completion marker or return value for every scripted step.

description: Auto-run scripts in a user's Fiji alter state before the frontend connects
mitigation: Launch with a controlled start-up (CR-A12-08), and snapshot globals after start-up (A11 CR-A11-03).

description: `System.exit` inside a macro kills the shared backend
mitigation: Use process-level supervision with automatic restart and state re-hydration from the structured history.

description: Users rely on C5 plugins (Weka, Cell Counter) that cannot be integrated beyond the fallback
mitigation: Make the fallback first-class: window tracking, result capture, clear hand-off

description: `HeadlessGenericDialog` gaps cause silent failures (no output file) when running headless
mitigation: Run IJ1 commands in a GUI-capable JVM by default; check output side effects after each command

description: Third-party update sites change behaviour after compatibility was classified
mitigation: Re-run classification when the installation's `db.xml.gz` checksum changes

description: A plugin calls `System.exit` (e.g. through `IJ.getImage()`) and terminates the shared JVM
mitigation: GUI-capable JVM (`ij != null` → `abort()` instead); session supervisor that restarts the JVM and restores state

description: Users believe exported PNG/JPEG figures preserve quantitative data
mitigation: Fidelity warning (CR-A14-02); separate "snapshot" action

description: Bio-Formats autoscaling changes displayed contrast between sessions, confusing "familiar semantics"
mitigation: Expose `autoscale`; record display ranges in history

description: Headless pipelines silently skip OME-TIFF export
mitigation: CR-A14-03; output existence checks

description: The unexplained OME-TIFF size inflation (P47) wastes storage or indicates wrong export settings
mitigation: Investigate with `showinf`; set compression explicitly

description: IJ1 windows pop up unexpectedly over the modern UI (M2)
mitigation: CR-A15-03 window tracker; batch mode by default

description: Shared IJ1 statics cause cross-talk between concurrent operations
mitigation: Serialise IJ1 commands per session on one worker queue; per-thread temp image

description: Modal dialog from a plugin blocks the worker invisibly
mitigation: Detect new `Dialog` windows (AWT event listener) and surface them; timeout warnings

description: Headless shortcuts are adopted for speed and break plugin compatibility
mitigation: CR-A15-09 gating with per-command evidence

description: Plugin or `IJ.getImage()` terminates the JVM
mitigation: CR-A15-08 supervisor; always keep a current image or check before commands

description: macOS main-thread/AppKit constraints break M2 hosting (PyImageJ documents them)
mitigation: Prefer the Jaunch-launched JVM as host on macOS; verify early (U-A15-4)

description: Accuracy on real users' speech (accents, microscope-room noise, masks) is lower than on TTS fixtures
mitigation: CR-A16-10; editable transcript (CR-A16-05); keyboard path always available

description: The vocabulary prompt introduces substitutions (P61 "pixel"→"cycle")
mitigation: Evaluate with and without the prompt; keep prompts short; the validator rejects unknown values

description: whisper.cpp Java bindings at 0c7be696 map `whisper_full_params` without the trailing `vad`, `vad_model_path` and `vad_params` fields (`bindings/java/.../params/WhisperFullParams.java#L335-L352` vs `include/whisper.h#L586-L591`). The struct is passed by value (`WhisperFullParams.ByValue`), so the native side may read undefined memory, and in-JVM crashes can take Fiji down
mitigation: Use a CLI/server child process; or generate bindings from the header and test before any in-process use

description: GPU path needs CUDA 12 cuBLAS DLLs that the ctranslate2 wheel does not bundle (P64), giving support burden and large redistributables
mitigation: CPU-only default (CR-A16-08)

description: Model licence ambiguity (MIT in openai/whisper README vs Apache-2.0 on the Hugging Face card)
mitigation: Record both in A28; both are permissive; obtain owner decision

description: faster-whisper has had no release since v1.2.1 (2025-10-31), almost a year before this review, while whisper.cpp releases monthly
mitigation: Pin versions; keep the worker interface engine-neutral (text plus segments plus confidences) so the engine can be swapped

description: Cold first load after reboot is slower than the measured 0.2 s (file-cache effect)
mitigation: Pre-load the worker at application start; measure in A30

description: A plausible but wrong command or parameter executes and changes scientific results unnoticed
mitigation: CR-A17-03/04/07; numerical comparison in evaluation

description: Over-clarification makes NL slower than menus, so users abandon it
mitigation: Remember explicit user choices per session, shown as chips; deterministic fast path (a)

description: Catalogue lacks consequential/units/chaining metadata (not in `IJ_Props.txt`)
mitigation: Add columns to `docs/data/commands.csv` (consequential, unit, creates_new_image, preconditions); curate the top commands by hand first

description: Plugin dialogs whose keys are not derivable statically (dynamic GenericDialogs, SciJava `@Parameter` commands)
mitigation: Harvest keys from Recorder output and SciJava module metadata; mark unknown commands as not NL-addressable

description: Prompt injection through metadata (image titles, file names) sent to an LLM
mitigation: Treat metadata as data in the prompt; the validator is authoritative; no code path

description: Model drift changes behaviour between versions
mitigation: Pin the model digest; per-model evaluation (CR-A17-10/12)

description: Hosted-LLM use leaks sensitive metadata
mitigation: CR-A17-08/09; redaction preview

description: Local LLM is unavailable on lab hardware (no GPU, disk)
mitigation: LLM optional (CR-A17-09)

description: Plugins mutate images outside `Executer`, so observed history is incomplete
mitigation: Digest-based change detection; label history entries "parameters unknown"

description: A `CommandListener` veto has side effects on plugins that expect to run
mitigation: Use veto only for policy (AC7). Test against the A13 categories.

description: Label whitespace collisions (A08) cause the wrong command to run
mitigation: Address commands by `command_id` in the catalogue, with the exact label string as stored data. Never use free text.

description: Queue serialisation makes the UI feel blocked during long operations
mitigation: Progress and cancel (A19, A20). Read-only queries served from the last digest.

description: Snapshot undo memory pressure on large microscopy stacks causes out-of-memory errors
mitigation: Budget, AC4 classification, virtual-stack detection (A23)

description: Legacy plugins change global settings or the current image outside the product's control, which defeats CR-A19-10
mitigation: Diff globals before and after each command (A20); flag unknown changes

description: Too much confirmation makes NL/voice slower than the menu, so users abandon it
mitigation: Auto-execute AC0/AC1; batch confirmation for multi-step plans (A17 §8)

description: Escape-based cancellation is ignored by plugins that never check `IJ.escapePressed()`
mitigation: CR-A19-08 messaging; JVM-level kill as a last resort, with session replay (CR-A19-11)

description: Hook chaining interferes with imagej-legacy behaviour
mitigation: Delegate every method; probe before adoption (CR-A20-03)

description: Asynchronous EDT `imageUpdated` events arrive after the worker reports completion, causing a stale render
mitigation: Render from the digest after completion; treat events as hints

description: Pixel hashing large images per action is slow
mitigation: Hash only affected planes; sample hashing for very large data (A23)

description: The team lacks Swing experience, so the hackathon UI is weak
mitigation: Prototype with Groovy-scripted Swing in Fiji; keep the existing demo as fallback (A31); O4 remains possible behind the same engine API

description: Java2D viewer performance is inadequate for large or high-zoom images
mitigation: D13 performance validation; JavaFX canvas contingency (O3 component); BigDataViewer for very large data

description: IJ1 windows pop up over the workspace (V2)
mitigation: Window policy and tracker (CR-A15-03)

description: Update-site distribution conflicts with users' other update sites (dependency versions)
mitigation: Depend only on jars already in core Fiji; pin and test on a fresh Fiji (D19)

description: macOS behaviour in M2 blocks cross-platform release
mitigation: Probe on macOS early; Jaunch launch mode

description: Users' Fiji installs differ from the pinned versions and break the product's assumptions
mitigation: CR-A22-03; depend only on stable core APIs; compatibility test matrix (D19)

description: Start-up time (about 5 s plus UI) feels slow compared with a web app
mitigation: Honest start-up state (CR-A20-06); the UI frame can appear early

description: The 75 % heap default competes with the speech worker and LLM memory
mitigation: Document the memory budget (A23); configurable heap

description: HiDPI rendering defects in legacy AWT windows
mitigation: Out of scope to fix upstream; note in UI; prefer modern components

description: Large stacks plus snapshots exhaust the heap
mitigation: CR-A23-02; AC4 handling; virtual stacks

description: Java2D rendering is insufficient at high zoom or for large planes
mitigation: CR-A23-03 measurement; R-b/R-d contingencies

description: Concurrent LLM and speech workloads degrade responsiveness on lab laptops
mitigation: LLM optional; CPU tiny/base models; show resource state

description: A bundled release breaches GPL or AGPL duties (missing source offer or notices)
mitigation: CR-A24-01/02/06; prefer installing the official Fiji archive by checksum, subject to Q-05

description: In-JVM bridge code becomes a combined work with GPL plugins against the owner's licence choice
mitigation: CR-A24-03; restrict the bridge to PD/BSD APIs; legal review (Q-01)

description: The speech runtime redistributes GPL encoders or proprietary DLLs unintentionally
mitigation: CR-A24-05; WAV input path; build a CPU-only minimal wheel set

description: The status of ImageJ1 as public domain outside the US is challenged
mitigation: Keep the disclaimer; legal question Q-03

description: Undeclared-licence jars (JAI, JPedal, JavaFX, JavaCPP presets) carry incompatible terms
The project's product name or branding implies endorsement by Fiji/ImageJ
mitigation: Naming decision DEC-001; trademark question Q-08

description: An LLM-proposed macro destroys or exfiltrates data
mitigation: CR-A25-04/10/11; constrained intermediate representation (§6.3)

description: The localhost bridge is abused by a local process or a future WebSocket route
Compromised update site or plugin
mitigation: CR-A25-06; pin the Fiji install by lock hash (existing `verify_runtime`)

description: Clinical identifiers leak through logs, prefs or prompts
mitigation: CR-A25-02/09; legal and institutional review

description: Hidden network egress breaks offline or air-gapped use
mitigation: CR-A25-13; Azul CRS verification

description: Security controls (confirmations) are so frequent that users approve without reading
mitigation: Confirm only deny-listed functions; usability test (A21)

description: "complete" targets slip but are still advertised
mitigation: Advertise status only from verification results (D18 coverage CSV). The UI states the compatibility category (PR-9).

description: ROI Manager singleton consistency (PAR-022) proves harder than expected
mitigation: Early validation spike in implementation milestone 1 (D20)

description: Users expect C5 plugins to work inside the modern canvas
mitigation: Clear "opens in Fiji window" indication (FR-PLUG-001)

description: Upstream sample URLs change or disappear (HTTP-only, 2017 timestamps)
mitigation: CR-A29-02 hash pinning; synthetic replacements

description: NC-SA data enters a redistributed artefact
mitigation: CR-A29-02; licence column checked in CI

description: Equivalence tests rely on visual comparison
mitigation: CR-A29-03; numerical tolerances (A30)

description: Speech tests overfit synthetic voices and fail on real users
mitigation: FX-061/FX-062; report results per accent group

description: DICOM samples carry identifiers
mitigation: Inspect headers; prefer synthetic DICOM if needed

description: GUI-mode reference runs are slow or flaky (dialogs, focus), so the equivalence suite is skipped
mitigation: Prefer headless-safe commands for the MVP; dialog-free option strings; timeouts and screen-saver-independent scripts (G4 experience)

description: Thread-order nondeterminism in 32-bit reductions causes false failures
mitigation: Per-command ULP tolerance flag, set only from evidence

description: Baselines quietly go stale after a runtime update
mitigation: CR-A30-04; CI checks that the lock hash matches the baseline

description: The independent reference generator also omits a key, so both sides use the same remembered default
mitigation: L1 test asserting that every schema key is present; reset plugin statics by running the reference in a fresh JVM
